profile.name: 电子秤后端抽象模块
profile.description: 用于实验室电子秤集成的非物理软件组件，定义清零、去皮和读取重量等通用控制接口，供上层实验自动化系统与具体电子秤实现对接。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for laboratory scale integration. It defines common control interfaces such as zeroing, taring, and reading weight, allowing higher-level lab automation software to interact with concrete scale implementations.

registry.name: 精密实验室天平
registry.description: 精密实验室天平是一款电子天平，主要功能包括归零校准、称量、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, tare等操作。
